description: This Java source file defines the ObjeniousProvider class, which implements the LoraProvider interface. It provides methods to extract device IDs, payloads, message types, and provides provider metadata like name and path prefix for Objenious, a LoRaWAN service provider.

classes.name: ObjeniousProvider
classes.description: A provider class for Objenious LoRaWAN messages, implementing methods to extract relevant data.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device ID (deveui) from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload (payload_cleartext) from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Determines the message type (join, uplink, downlink, unknown) based on the 'type' field in the JSON message.
